item.title: V1.0.0 Phoenix 🌿
item.description:
Changelog

  1. QingWu's first release: forked from MiaoYan (MIT) as an independent product, new brand and icon
  2. First-class Logseq graph support: open a graph and read it, never writes inside the vault, conflict backups stay in the app directory
  3. Logseq syntax rendering: TODO task badges, folded property lines, tab-indented outlines as nested lists
  4. Full wikilink resolution: aliases, case-insensitive matching, namespace filename mapping, dead links create pages on click
  5. ((uuid)) block refs expand inline in preview and export; backlink panel data is unified and accurate
  6. Today's Journal quick access (cmd+shift+D) with Logseq-compatible journals/yyyy_MM_dd.md naming
  7. Everything MiaoYan had: live preview, slide mode, version history, iCloud sync, LaTeX/Mermaid

更新日志

  1. 青梧首个版本：基于妙言（MiaoYan，MIT 许可）fork 独立演进，全新品牌与图标
  2. Logseq 库一等支持：直接打开 graph 即可阅读，绝不写入库内文件，冲突备份存于应用目录
  3. Logseq 语法渲染：TODO 任务徽章、属性行折叠、tab 缩进大纲渲染为多级列表
  4. wikilink 完整解析：别名、大小写不敏感、namespace 文件名映射，点击死链自动创建页面
  5. ((uuid)) 块引用在预览与导出中内联展开，双链面板数据归一准确
  6. 今日笔记快捷入口（cmd+shift+D），journals/yyyy_MM_dd.md 与 Logseq 命名一致
  7. 完整继承妙言体验：实时预览、PPT 模式、版本历史、iCloud 同步、LaTeX/Mermaid
